title: Boolean and analytic influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The probability that flipping coordinate $i$ changes $f$ equals the average squared discrete derivative of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ in coordinate $i$.
